facts.business: PTC India Financial Services Limited is a registered Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) with Infrastructure Finance Company (IFC) status, providing total financing solutions to the energy value chain including power generation, transmission, distribution, fuel resources, and road infrastructure projects.
key_risks: Impairment of Loans and Advances (Expected Credit Loss Allowance) involving significant management judgement in staging, probability of default, loss given default, and forward-looking estimates
